title: Fleet overview
description: All clusters side by side, by name: what is enrolled and what is sending, how many nodes and pods each has and whether they are healthy, how long since each last sent data, what the agents cost, the node inventory, and the Ikhnos applications. Start here, then follow a cluster into Clusters and nodes or Delivery health.

list.name: cluster
list.label: Cluster
list.description: The clusters, by name. All includes a cluster whose name the server does not know (shown by its id).

list.name: Agents joined or left
list.textFormat: The server's connected agents changed; see Ikhnos self.

links.title: Clusters and nodes
links.tooltip: Nodes, pods and namespaces of the chosen clusters

links.title: Ikhnos self
links.tooltip: The server and the agents themselves

panels.title: Clusters known
panels.description: Clusters Ikhnos has enrolled and given a name (the server writes ikhnos_cluster_info every minute). Zero is orange: nothing is enrolled, or the server is not writing its series into FUSION.

panels.title: Clusters sending data
panels.description: Clusters whose telemetry has reached FUSION recently. Fewer than the clusters known means a cluster is enrolled and silent; the Delivery health dashboard says since when.

panels.title: Agents connected
panels.description: Agents with an open stream to the Ikhnos server. A cluster can send telemetry with its agent disconnected and the other way round; this and the one beside it are different questions.

panels.title: Slowest cluster, seconds since data

targets.expr: max(time() - (max by (ikhnos_cluster_id) (timestamp({ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", ikhnos_cluster_id!="", __name__!~"ikhnos_application_info|ikhnos_agent_self_.*"})) or max by (ikhnos_cluster_id) (max_over_time(timestamp({ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", ikhnos_cluster_id!="", __name__!~"ikhnos_application_info|ikhnos_agent_self_.*"})[1d:5m]))))

panels.description: How long ago the quietest cluster last sent anything, by any metric. Amber from 3 minutes, red from 15.

panels.title: Nodes not ready
panels.description: Nodes Kubernetes reports as not ready, over the chosen clusters.

panels.title: Pods not running
panels.description: Pods that are neither Running nor Succeeded (Pending, Failed or Unknown), over the chosen clusters.

panels.title: Nodes
panels.description: Nodes that report their readiness, over the chosen clusters.

panels.title: Pods running
panels.description: Pods in the Running phase.

panels.title: Restarts in the last hour
panels.description: Container restarts across the chosen clusters in the last hour.

panels.title: Applications
panels.description: Ikhnos applications that have at least one service Ikhnos can match with telemetry (the server writes ikhnos_application_info every minute).

panels.title: Largest agent
panels.description: Resident memory of the agent that uses the most; see Ikhnos self for every agent.

panels.title: Busiest node CPU
panels.description: The most heavily used node's CPU as a share of what Kubernetes can allocate on it.

panels.description: Each node with whether it is ready, how much of its allocatable CPU, memory and disk is in use, and its size. Colours turn amber from 70 % and red from 90 %.

panels.title: Pods running

targets.expr: (count by (ikhnos_cluster_id) (k8s_pod_phase{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster"} == 2)) * on (ikhnos_cluster_id) group_left (cluster_name) label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "ikhnos_cluster_id", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name) label_replace((count by (ikhnos_cluster_id) (k8s_pod_phase{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster"} == 2)), "cluster_name", "$1", "ikhnos_cluster_id", "(.+)")

panels.description: Pods in the Running phase in each cluster, stacked, so the top line is the estate.

panels.title: Nodes not ready

targets.expr: (count by (ikhnos_cluster_id) (k8s_node_condition_ready{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster"} != 1)) * on (ikhnos_cluster_id) group_left (cluster_name) label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "ikhnos_cluster_id", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name) label_replace((count by (ikhnos_cluster_id) (k8s_node_condition_ready{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster"} != 1)), "cluster_name", "$1", "ikhnos_cluster_id", "(.+)")

panels.description: Nodes Kubernetes reports as not ready, per cluster. A cluster with no line has none.

panels.title: Busiest node CPU in each cluster

targets.expr: (max by (ikhnos_cluster_id) (100 * k8s_node_cpu_usage{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster"} / on (ikhnos_cluster_id, k8s_node_name) k8s_node_allocatable_cpu{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster"})) * on (ikhnos_cluster_id) group_left (cluster_name) label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "ikhnos_cluster_id", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name) label_replace((max by (ikhnos_cluster_id) (100 * k8s_node_cpu_usage{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster"} / on (ikhnos_cluster_id, k8s_node_name) k8s_node_allocatable_cpu{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster"})), "cluster_name", "$1", "ikhnos_cluster_id", "(.+)")

panels.description: For each cluster, the most heavily used node's CPU as a share of what can be allocated on it. The dashed line is where nodes start to have little room.

panels.title: Busiest node memory in each cluster

targets.expr: (max by (ikhnos_cluster_id) (100 * k8s_node_memory_working_set_bytes{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster"} / on (ikhnos_cluster_id, k8s_node_name) k8s_node_allocatable_memory_bytes{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster"})) * on (ikhnos_cluster_id) group_left (cluster_name) label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "ikhnos_cluster_id", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name) label_replace((max by (ikhnos_cluster_id) (100 * k8s_node_memory_working_set_bytes{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster"} / on (ikhnos_cluster_id, k8s_node_name) k8s_node_allocatable_memory_bytes{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster"})), "cluster_name", "$1", "ikhnos_cluster_id", "(.+)")

panels.description: For each cluster, the most heavily used node's working-set memory as a share of what can be allocated on it.

panels.title: Container restarts by cluster

targets.expr: (sum by (ikhnos_cluster_id) (increase(k8s_container_restarts{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval]))) * on (ikhnos_cluster_id) group_left (cluster_name) label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "ikhnos_cluster_id", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name) label_replace((sum by (ikhnos_cluster_id) (increase(k8s_container_restarts{ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster"}[$__rate_interval]))), "cluster_name", "$1", "ikhnos_cluster_id", "(.+)")

panels.description: Container restarts in each cluster per interval. A burst in one cluster only is an application or node problem there; the same burst in all is usually a rollout.

panels.title: Series arriving, by cluster

targets.expr: (count by (ikhnos_cluster_id) ({ikhnos_cluster_id=~".+", ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", __name__!~"ikhnos_application_info|ikhnos_agent_self_.*"})) * on (ikhnos_cluster_id) group_left (cluster_name) label_replace(topk by (cluster) (1, ikhnos_cluster_info), "ikhnos_cluster_id", "$1", "cluster", "(.+)") or ignoring (cluster_name) label_replace((count by (ikhnos_cluster_id) ({ikhnos_cluster_id=~".+", ikhnos_cluster_id=~"$cluster", __name__!~"ikhnos_application_info|ikhnos_agent_self_.*"})), "cluster_name", "$1", "ikhnos_cluster_id", "(.+)")

panels.description: How many series each cluster is delivering to FUSION. A line that falls to nothing is a cluster that stopped sending.

panels.title: Ikhnos applications

count by (application, application_id) (count by (application, application_id, k8s_namespace_name, ikhnos_cluster_id) (ikhnos_application_info))
